lines.text: The righteous and the wise are in God's hands, and there is one fate for everyone.
There is hope for the living, because a live dog is better than a dead lion.
The living know they will die, but the dead know nothing, and their memory is forgotten.
Eat your bread with joy and drink your wine, and enjoy life with your sons and daughters.
Do your work with all your might, for the race is not to the swift, and men are like sheep scattered on the hills.
